run_profile_analyzer: run the profile analyzer CLI to process a latency trace file and output a formatted table
run_percentile: run the percentile function to compute p50, p90, or p99 of a sorted list of values
review_CallStackBuilder: review the CallStackBuilder class that parses JSON trace lines and builds call stack scopes
review_CallStack: review the CallStack class that aggregates identical call stacks by MD5 signature for percentile analysis
review_ScopeBuilder: review the ScopeBuilder class that tracks function scope timing and computes self time and child timings
